title: Education-Training Sector Strategy 2023-2030
why_not: Describes the census only: the EMIS it plans to strengthen is data collection by questionnaires that school institutions fill in, feeding the school map and the sectoral yearbooks, with ICT to be introduced 'in a controlled manner' and collection to be funded on ministry budgets; no learner record, no learner identifier, no statement that learner records are on paper. Over 20,000 words, read around the study's terms.
